description:
Implement `OctoPi.AI.Runner.Anthropic`.

- `api/0` → `:anthropic_messages`.
- `default_base_url/0` → `"https://api.anthropic.com/v1"`.
- `auth/0` → `{:env, "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"}`.
- `validate/1` — accepts `base_url` override and per-model overrides.
- `lookup/2` → `:unsupported` (no live `/models` endpoint we want to depend on).
- `discover/1` → `:unsupported`.

**Tests:**
- Auth resolves from env var.
- Auth.json override works.
- `base_url` override propagates to `Model.base_url`.
- `lookup/2` returns `:unsupported` cleanly.
- Catalog comes purely from models.json entries (hand-curated).

The `:anthropic_messages` codec already exists — this ticket is just the runner side.
title: Runner: :anthropic
